data.name: Kirraam
data.gender_notes: Kirraam is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'karr', meaning 'to send, to deliver a message'. In Islamic context, refers to the messenger or prophet sent by Allah to guide humanity. The name Kirraam carries the meaning “Messenger, Apostle” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Kirraam usually hope their child will grow to embody messenger, apostle and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name filled with spiritual significance for Muslims, symbolizing the connection between the divine and the human.
data.etymology: Kirraam belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Messenger, Apostle.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kirraam total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.name: كِرام
in_arabic.meaning: أصل الكلمة من الكِرام، و هو من أسماء الله الحسنى، يعني الكرامة، العز، الكرم
